scope: Traffic-stop education and device-local evidence tools. Federal baseline; limited official California traffic-stop summary. No comprehensive state procedure packs. ZIP suggests a state and requires confirmation.
hash_note: Hashes describe the published Git blobs (canonical line endings), not Windows working-copy line endings.
rights_report_logging: Verbatim person-reported rights violations, device timestamps, timeline markers and export. Reports are not automatic legal findings.
amendment_checklist: 27 topic checks over reported accounts, not independent legal reasoning or a determination of applicability. Brief summaries link to full primary text. No absent flag rules out a violation.
explicit_amendment_references: Numbers, ordinal names and Roman numerals are recognized as requests for topic review, not proof of a violation.
presentation: Constitution-led live prompts, verbatim encounter recording and personal choice. Jurisdictional requirements and current treatment retained as separate legal context. No automatic declaration that every demand is optional or any reported stop was lawful/unlawful.
license_request_reply: Fifth Amendment: you may decline investigative questions and avoid compelled self-incrimination. You can say, “I am exercising my right to remain silent.” The document request is in your timeline.

continuation_replies.stop: Stop reported. Fourth Amendment: protection against unreasonable detention. Your account and a review flag are in the timeline.
continuation_replies.license: Fifth Amendment: you may decline investigative questions and avoid compelled self-incrimination. You can say, “I am exercising my right to remain silent.” The document request is in your timeline.
continuation_replies.silence: Your decision to remain silent is logged.
continuation_replies.window: The window order is logged. Your Fourth and Fifth Amendment protections continue. Keep your hands visible.
continuation_replies.exit: The exit order is logged. Your constitutional protections continue. Avoid physical resistance.
continuation_replies.both: Both orders are logged. Your constitutional protections continue. Keep your hands visible and avoid physical resistance.

threat_reply: Safety alert: force or a threat was reported. Fourth Amendment: protection against unreasonable force. You can request a supervisor. Keep your hands visible; avoid physical resistance.
